newsitem.title: USA: Coastal Corp opens terminal in Estonia.
newsitem.headline: Coastal Corp opens terminal in Estonia.

text.p: Coastal Corp said Thursday that a company it owns with Baltica Finance NV opened a terminal on the Baltic Sea to market petroleum products.

The terminal was opened in Tallinn, Estonia. It will be used to market petroleum products that come primarily from Russia and the former Soviet Union republics for buyers in Europe, North and South America and the Caribbean.
The terminal will be operated by E.O.S. Ltd, an Estonian subsidiary of Coastal Baltica Holding Ltd. Coastal Baltica is a joint venture of Baltica Finance NV and Coastal CFC Ltd, a Coastal subsidiary.
The new terminal is expected to be used to import and export nearly 2.5 million metric tonnes, or 16 million barrels, of petroleum products each year, Coastal Corp said.
Under the venture, the terminal was renovated and a 4.6 mile pipeline was built to connect it with the Port of Muuga, a deep water port in the Baltic. The cost was not disclosed.
Baltica Finance NV is a privately held Swedish-Dutch company involved primarily in energy, shipping, forestry and deep-sea fishing industries. Coastal is an energy holding company based in Houston.
